description: Put back what one move_threads call moved, for the threads you name. Each thread answers done (put back), unchanged (moved again since, put back already, or not moved by that call: left as it is), notFound, folderMissing, moveUnsupported, or failed (an error on our side: ask again). A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

threadIds.description: The threads to put back: the ones the call moved. One moved again since, or put back already, is left alone.

name: undo_thread_moves
title: Undo a bulk move
